name: Lack of Surplus
summary: Dar is gathering supplies for the outpost by the beach in the east, where Tok'Kar has little time to spare between guard shifts and cooking for the soldiers. Dar asks you to bring Tok'Kar a shipment of sawtooth meat.

sections.title: Supplies for the Shore
sections.body: Dar is collecting supplies for the outpost by the beach in the east. Tok'Kar does what is possible there, but guard shifts and cooking for the soldiers leave little time in the day. The soldiers enjoy cooking sawtooth meat when they can get it, and Dar has had no time to send them another shipment.

sections.title: Choosing the Meat
sections.body: Dar warns you to leave the young sawtooths alone, for the older ones taste better. The young need a year or two to reach full size. Eight unprepared sawtooth flanks are wanted, brought to Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Who is requesting the sawtooth meat?
faq.answer: Dar, who is gathering supplies for the outpost by the beach in the east.
At the outpost by the beach in the east that Dar speaks of. The meat is to be delivered to Tok'Kar there, in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Why does Tok'Kar need others to bring meat?
faq.answer: Between guard shifts and cooking for the soldiers, Tok'Kar has little time left in the day.
The older ones. The young are less tasty, and need a year or two to reach full size.
Eight unprepared sawtooth flanks, brought to Tok'Kar.

faq.q: What comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: A second step under the same name follows.
